question.problem:
$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=-2{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t)+4{t}^{2}+t-2 \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=3{x}_{1}(t)-{t}^{2}+5t+6\end{aligned}
$$

Write the system of linear ODEs in matrix form.
question.worked_solution:
First, let's rewrite our system, highlighting the coefficients:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=(-2)\cdot {x}_{1}(t)+(-1)\cdot {x}_{2}(t)+4\cdot {t}^{2}+1\cdot t+(-2) \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=3\cdot {x}_{1}(t)+0\cdot {x}_{2}(t)+(-1)\cdot {t}^{2}+5\cdot t+6\end{aligned}
$$
